title: Preserve read-only evaluations during inspection
description: Allow successful read-only inspection tools during a pending goal evaluation while keeping mutating tool activity stale; add adapter regression coverage and verify the project and context updates.

logs.msg: Confirmed bug in extensions/pi-goal/index.ts: every successful non-control tool currently invalidates a pending evaluation, including read-only inspection. Implementing the requested read-only exception and regression tests.

Implemented read-only evaluation preservation, host-tool-preserving synchronization, and mid-cycle goal run startup. Added regressions for read-only inspection, mutating-tool staleness, tool availability, and provider-cycle creation. Verification passed: bunx tsc --noEmit; bun test (31 passed, 66 expectations); git diff --check.
